name: CRM field ownership map
summary: Before a CRM sync or field mapping changes, the systems owner gets a field map from the supplied exports and sample records: each field's source, match keys and conflict rule, with unclear keys, consent fields and duplicates left as questions for each field's owner.

sources.title: Mapping shared fields between two systems from supplied schema exports, approved definitions and sample records: the header check that stops on a mismatch, pairing only what the planned mapping states, a source named only where the definitions name one, match keys tested for blanks, repeats, overlap and agreement with a stored cross-reference, fields compared on matched pairs, consent fields held out, and every open point written as a question for the field's business owner, written for this template.
